about.description: rcUSDp is the yield-bearing twin of rcUSD: stake rcUSD and the staking pool escrows it as a Balance<RCUSD> in PoolInner.staked, minting non-rebasing rcUSDp whose redemption value rises as the underlying money-market book accrues. WRAPPER, NOT A SEPARATE ASSET: as of 2026-10-19 the pool escrows 8,276,744.98 rcUSD against 7,683,875.94 rcUSDp, and that escrowed rcUSD is already inside rcUSD's 18,276,755.54 TreasuryCap supply - listing this as an Asset would double count 8.28m, about 45% of R25's Sui book. Ember's R25 Treasury vault holds 7,456,999.92 rcUSDp (97% of supply) behind its mrcUSD receipt, so mrcUSD nests inside this. Priced on-chain by the r25Sui coins adapter: USDC x (PoolInner.staked / rcUSDp supply), 1.0771575 rcUSD per share on 2026-10-19.
